review_candidates.title: IT System Administrator
review_candidates.description: POSITION SUMMARY The System Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and support of the organization's IT infrastructure, including servers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, and related technologies. This position helps ensure the availability, reliability, and security of systems by performing routine maintenance, monitoring system and network performance, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing approved changes. The System Administrator works closely with IT teams, vendors, and business users to resolve incidents, support technology initiatives, and maintain a stable computing environment. The position requires foundational system administration knowledge with the ability to manage assigned infrastructure tasks independently while following established procedures, security standards, and operational best practices, and provides technical support for escalated issues from service desk and end-user support teams. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES System Administration and Infrastructure Support  Manage and maintain servers, operating systems, applications, storage systems, file shares, and related IT infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers. Administer Windows and Linux systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, Group Policy, user accounts, security groups, permissions, and access management. Manage and troubleshoot LAN/WAN and network infrastructure, including TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and network connectivity.  Monitor system performance, availability, capacity, and network health and take appropriate corrective action when issues are identified. Manage backup configuration and monitoring, backup verification, file and system restoration, disaster recovery procedures, recovery testing, and business continuity documentation.  Maintain system and endpoint security through security patching, antivirus and EDR management, access controls, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and support for security incidents. Support virtualization platforms, including VMware and Hyper-V.  Support Microsoft 365 and cloud environments such as Azure and AWS, including cloud infrastructure, user and access administration, email and collaboration services, and business application infrastructure.  Provide desktop and endpoint support for Windows workstations and laptops, including operating system configuration, software installation and troubleshooting, hardware troubleshooting, endpoint security, and patch management.  Investigate and resolve system, network, and infrastructure incidents; perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.  Automate routine administrative tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting and automation tools as appropriate. Maintain accurate IT documentation, system configurations, procedures, infrastructure records, and operational documentation. Coordinate with vendors and service providers to resolve technical issues and support infrastructure needs and projects. Support IT projects, system upgrades, migrations, technology initiatives, and infrastructure improvements. Ensure assigned systems and activities comply with IT security policies, standards, and operational procedures. Support onboarding and offboarding activities related to system access, account administration, permissions, and technology setup as assigned. Perform other related IT duties as assigned based on business needs. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS   Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in system administration, IT infrastructure, or a related position.   Strong knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux administration.   Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Group Policy.   Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.   Experience troubleshooting routers, switches, firewalls, and network connectivity.   Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or other virtualization technologies.   Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, and system security.   Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or other cloud platforms is preferred.   Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting and automation tools is an advantage.   Strong knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and access management.   Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and perform root-cause analysis.   Strong documentation, communication, and organizational skills.   Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an IT team.   Ability to prioritize incidents and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT This position is primarily performed in a professional office environment and regularly requires sitting, using a computer, communicating in person and electronically, and handling standard office materials. The employee may occasionally stand, walk, bend, reach, and lift or move items weighing up to 15 pounds.   This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. The employee may be assigned other job-related duties based on business needs and in accordance with applicable law.

The role ensures proactive identification and remediation of system and network issues, supports cybersecurity initiatives to safeguard CUI and other sensitive information, and provides responsive technical support to employee‑owners in alignment with AVIAN’s IT Management Policy. Working closely with the SharePoint Administrator and IT/Cybersecurity Specialist, the Systems/Network Administrator executes daily operational tasks, assists with incident response, implements corrective actions, and helps maintain existing documentation and audit readiness across the enterprise environment. Join a Company Where You Can Make a Real Impact - and Own a Piece of the Future Are you energized by the idea of helping a company grow smarter, serve our customers better, and connect more deeply? Do you thrive in an environment where your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work drives real results? If so, we’d love to meet you. We’re a mid-sized, employee-owned company on a mission to create meaningful value for both our employees and our customers. That means we’re not just looking for someone to fill a seat — we’re looking for someone who wants to build, innovate, and evolve with us. Our company primarily serves the Navy and other Department of Defense clients, offering a dynamic environment where your expertise will make a difference. Systems/Network Administrator Responsibilities Monitor, maintain, and optimize enterprise systems and network infrastructure (servers, switches, firewalls, endpoints, VPN, wireless, authentication services). Conduct routine health checks, patching, upgrades, and configuration changes to maintain availability, stability, and performance. Support proactive cybersecurity policies and procedures; assist with discovery, verification, and documentation of cyber incidents. Execute remediation steps during IT incidents in coordination with IT leadership; support digital forensics and technical remediation efforts as directed. Apply corrective actions related to vulnerabilities, configuration drift, audit findings, and compliance requirements. Administer asset lifecycle activities, including acquisition, installation, tracking, maintenance, and decommissioning of hardware and software. Serve as the primary point of contact for employee helpdesk requests. Provide timely end‑user support for account management, access, device setup, and troubleshooting; collaborate with HR/Ops and Security on onboarding and offboarding processes.
